schedule_basis: HKEX circular explicitly closes the securities market on Saturdays, Sundays and the listed public holidays; three listed half-days remain trading sessions.
limits: Scheduled securities-market sessions; does not claim future ad-hoc suspensions/unscheduled closures.
For HK underlying-stock close-to-close RV sessions, not settlement/stock-connect/derivative-expiry calendars.
Half-day counts as one completed daily close session.
Only this full documented calendar year is evidenced; no extrapolation to 2028.

source.publisher: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited / HKEX
source.title: Hong Kong Securities Market Holiday Schedule for Year 2027
